preconditions.description: The first argument must be a string and the second must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (0 <= n < len(s) and s[n].lower() in {'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u'})
postconditions.description: The function returns true if and only if the character at position n in the string s exists and is a vowel (case-insensitive).
